description: One pool (by its id or its code): rules, entry fee, which wallet to pay (if it has an entry fee), members and their payments, and matches with your predictions. Each match has matchId (for submit_predictions), eventId (ESPN), state and canPredict: "open" can be predicted until closesAt; "teams_tbd" a team is still to be defined; "delayed" should have started and has not. registrationOpen tells whether you can still join (isOpen only says it is public). Members' wallets are only visible to members of a pool with an entry fee.

poolId.description: the pool's id (its join code also works)
